text:
Ravi: Quick midweek check  whos still alive in the office fantasy playoff bracket? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Nina: I am? Barely. Woke up on a double-quartet of injuries. :face_with_thermometer:

Cooper: Cooper still alive. My bench did the thing. Weird flex.

Elle: Dumped my worst player yesterday, riding the hot waiver wire picks.

Baker: I lost to automation (bench bot) but am bringing snacks as penance. Cookies incoming.

Ravi: Bakers cookies are a good compensation. Also small prize idea: winner gets a $25 coffee card + a silly crown. ACE.

Nina: Crown please. I will wear it on video calls.

Cooper: Can we get a photo of crown-wearer for posterity? :camera_with_flash:

SnackyBot: Snack suggestion: "Corner Bakery" cookie dozen $10. ETA 25-35 min. Deliver to 5th floor kitchen.

Elle: Also, mini-poll: who wants a post-season bracket brag post in #general? Yes/No

Ravi: Yes from me. Promote the glory.

Baker: Yes but only if I win.

Nina: No, privacy for my tears.

Cooper: Yes. Gloat responsibly.

Ravi: Cool. If finals are this week let's schedule a short selfie-and-crown moment.

Baker: If I win Ill also bring celebratory (non-alcoholic) bubbly.

SnackyBot: Order queued: cookie dozen x1.

Ravi: Alright team  may the best bench survive.
